issue.title: Stabilize the Artifacts navigation p95 benchmark
issue.description: Proposed by sase-dd.7. The Artifacts j/k benchmark exceeded the 16 ms p95 budget in two verification runs on different actions despite low medians, while two fresh standalone runs passed. Investigate scheduler and renderer outliers, make the measurement robust without weakening the user-visible latency budget, and preserve coverage for both Beads and Files navigation paths.
